notes.subject: יבצר
notes.rationale: Crux: 'cut off' (KJV/ASV), 'gathers/restrains' (YLT), 'minishes' (JPS) — root בצר means both 'cut off' and 'fortify/gather'; 'holim ananit' (hold down) chosen as middle reading.

notes.subject: ruak bilong ol lida
notes.rationale: רוח here is the life-breath/spirit of princes, not wind; Tok Pisin 'ruak' keeps the one Hebrew word.

notes.subject: נורא
notes.rationale: Participle of ירא 'fear' — same root for 'fear' and 'cause fear': God is fearsome, the kings are afraid; one Hebrew root, two Tok Pisin phrases.

translation: Em i holim ananit ruak bilong ol lida; em i man ol i gutpela long en, long ol king bilong graun.
